reapack.name: Phase Rotation (RX-style).lua
reapack.desc: Phase Rotation (RX-style): suggest, preview and render broadband phase rotation for selected items

version.author: dennech
version.changelog: Suggest now reproduces iZotope RX 10's values (L8 criterion, RX sign convention). New engine: with the reaper_phaserot extension the rotation is applied to the item's source (no files, no take FX, waveform updates immediately, plain project file). Adaptive mode with look-ahead interpolation matches RX's adaptive peaks. Take-FX engine kept as fallback.

reapack.name: reaper_phaserot
reapack.desc: Phase rotation source engine for the Phase Rotation (RX-style) script
